sloka: यदैव च जनस्थाने राक्षसैर्बहुभिर्वृतः ।खरस्तव हतो भ्राता तदेवासौ न मानुषः ।। ६.११४.९ ।।
transliteration: yadaiva ca janasthāne rākṣasairbahubhirvṛtaḥ ।kharastava hato bhrātā tadevāsau na mānuṣaḥ ।। 6.114.9 ।।

translations.english: " At Janasthana your brother Khara, who was surrounded by many Rakshasas, was killed by a mortal in the same manner."
